notice: Synthetic, hand-labelled contract excerpts written for this benchmark. They are NOT real contracts. Labels record what a careful human reviewer would mark; they were written before running the engine and must not be edited to match its output. Results measure Legal Buddy's rule engine on this small set only and do not establish accuracy on real-world contracts.

labelGuide.clauses: Every clause category a reviewer would expect Legal Buddy to identify in the text (Payment, Termination, Confidentiality, Liability, Intellectual Property, Governing Law, Dispute Resolution, Renewal, Penalties).
labelGuide.risk: Reviewer's risk level for that clause: Low, Medium, High or Needs Review.
labelGuide.compliance: Indian-law rule ids a reviewer would flag (see src/services/insights/indian-law-checks.ts).

---PAGE_1---
MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
This Master Services Agreement is entered into on 1 April 2026 between Alpha Retail Pvt Ltd (Client) and Beta Systems LLP (Service Provider). Stamp duty has been paid on e-stamp paper.
1. PAYMENT TERMS
Payment terms: Client shall pay all undisputed invoices within 30 days of receipt.
2. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
Limitation of liability: in no event shall the Service Provider's liability be limited, and the Service Provider shall indemnify the Client for all losses without any cap.
---PAGE_2---
3. TERM AND TERMINATION
Term and termination: either party may terminate this Agreement by giving 30 days written notice; either party may terminate for material breach not cured within 15 days.
4. GOVERNING LAW
Governing law: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and the courts in Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.

---PAGE_1---
EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT
This employment agreement is made on 10 June 2026 between Gamma Tech Pvt Ltd (Employer) and Ms. R. Sharma (Employee).
Compensation: The Employer shall pay a monthly salary of INR 85,000 within 7 days of the end of each month.
Non-compete: The Employee shall not engage in or be employed by any competing business in India for a period of two (2) years after the termination of employment.
Confidential information: The Employee shall hold all confidential information in strict confidence and protect it with reasonable care during and after employment.
Termination: Either party may terminate employment by giving 60 days written notice.
This agreement is governed by the laws of India and the courts at Pune have jurisdiction.

---PAGE_1---
SUPPLY AGREEMENT
This supply agreement dated 5 May 2026 is between Delta Foods Pvt Ltd (Buyer) and Epsilon Packaging (Supplier). The agreement is executed on stamp paper of the appropriate value.
Liquidated damages: If delivery is delayed, the Supplier shall pay liquidated damages in the amount of 2% of the order value per week of delay.
Payment terms: The Buyer shall pay within 45 days of invoice.
Dispute resolution: All disputes shall be referred to arbitration by a sole arbitrator under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, after good faith negotiations fail.
Governing law: the laws of India shall apply and courts in Nagpur shall have jurisdiction.

---PAGE_1---
MUTUAL NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT
This non-disclosure agreement is entered into on 2 July 2026 between Zeta Labs Pvt Ltd and Eta Analytics LLP. E-stamp certificate number IN-MH-000000 is attached.
Confidential information: each party shall hold the other party's confidential information in strict confidence, protect it with the same degree of care it uses for its own information, and this obligation shall survive indefinitely.
Governing law: This Agreement is governed by the laws of India and the courts at Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction.

---PAGE_1---
SOFTWARE LICENSE AGREEMENT
This SaaS agreement is made on 1 August 2026 between Theta Cloud Pvt Ltd (Provider) and Iota Clinics (Customer). Stamp duty paid under the Maharashtra Stamp Act.
The Provider will store patient personal data and customer data uploaded by the Customer on its servers.
Fees and expenses: The Customer shall pay the annual subscription fee within 30 days of invoice.
Intellectual property: All intellectual property in the platform shall belong to the Provider, and the Provider retains all rights in pre-existing tools.
Automatic renewal: This agreement shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms unless written notice is given 60 days prior to expiration.
Governing law: laws of India; courts at Mumbai.

---PAGE_1---
CONSULTING AGREEMENT
This consulting agreement dated 3 March 2026 is between Kappa Advisors and Lambda Infra Pvt Ltd, executed on non-judicial stamp paper.
Payment terms: Lambda shall pay the consultant's fee within 15 days of each invoice.
Claims: Any claim arising out of this Agreement must be brought within 3 months of the event giving rise to it, failing which the claim shall stand waived.
The Consultant waives the right to sue the Client in any court for any matter relating to this Agreement.
Termination for convenience: Lambda may terminate immediately without notice at its sole discretion.

---PAGE_1---
LEAVE AND LICENSE AGREEMENT
This leave and license agreement is made on 1 September 2026 between Mr. A. Patil (Licensor) and Mr. S. Khan (Licensee) for Flat 12, Kothrud, Pune.
The Licensee shall pay a monthly license fee of Rs. 25,000 on or before the 5th day of each month.
The license is for 11 months and may be renewed by mutual written agreement.
Either party may terminate this agreement by giving one month's written notice.

---PAGE_1---
SERVICES AGREEMENT
This services agreement dated 15 January 2026 is between Mu Logistics Pvt Ltd and Nu Software LLP and is duly stamped.
Limitation of liability: in no event shall either party's aggregate liability exceed and it is capped at the total fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
Intellectual property: Upon full payment, the Service Provider assigns all right, title, and interest in the deliverables to the Client.
Payment terms: The Client shall pay invoices within 30 days.
Arbitration: Disputes shall be resolved by arbitration; the seat of arbitration shall be Mumbai and the arbitral tribunal shall consist of a sole arbitrator.
Governing law: laws of India.

---PAGE_1---
AGENCY AGREEMENT
This agency agreement dated 20 February 2026 between Xi Distributors and Omicron Brands Pvt Ltd is executed on e-stamp paper.
Invoicing: The Distributor shall pay each invoice within 30 days; overdue amounts shall carry interest at 2% per month together with collection fees and attorney fees.
Late fee: a late fee of Rs. 5,000 shall pay for each delayed monthly report.
The Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India and courts at Delhi have jurisdiction.

---PAGE_1---
LETTER OF INTENT
This letter records that Pi Ventures and Rho Foods intend to discuss a possible partnership. It does not create binding obligations and is not a contract. The parties will meet next month to discuss next steps.
